paragraphs.source_en: Jaime left brothels and whores to his brother Tyrion; Cersei was the only woman he had ever wanted. “The girls pleasured some of my lord father’s soldiers, it would seem. Perhaps served them food and drink. Lord Jonos might have ordered them killed. My father burned his castle, I fear he loves us not.”
